correctness.rationale: Proof identifies K as a good circular-arc nerve with each candidate triangle boundary a primitive circle, classifies exactly two additional 2-simplices for two disjoint reversals, proves a unique additional tetrahedron only at maximal separation, and constructs a free-face collapse in that case. Direct independent enumeration for 21 configurations verifies face claims and all proposed combinatorial collapses; mod-two ranks corroborate small cases. The infinite classification is proved structurally, not inferred from finite checks.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete sharp infinite-family homotopy transition for two natural local defects in canonical cyclic tournament topology. The abrupt sphere-versus-contractible distinction hinges on a single additional tetrahedron and is not a routine relabeling or small numerical improvement.
